'''Travik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he was part of the Imperial forces that worked to secure the captured [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] after the Empire [[Assault on Tython|raided]] the world, and he commanded the Imperial forces in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] from the ruins of the [[Gnarls Outpost]]. However, he was slain defending the Gnarls from Republic forces.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Major Travik appears as the first boss of the Republic version of the Tactical Flashpoint "Assault on Tython," which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.7: Invasion. For Imperial players, the second boss is Major [[Imos]], and the two share many of their game mechanics.<ref name="TOR" />
